ping.description: Health check — returns the bot's current WebSocket latency.

help.description: Learn about FlynnBot and how to set up commands via the dashboard.

ban.description: Permanently ban a member from the server.

kick.description: Kick a member from the server.

warn.description: Issue a formal warning to a member.

mute.description: Timeout (mute) a member for a specified duration.

unmute.description: Remove a timeout from a member.

softban.description: Ban then immediately unban a user to purge their recent messages.

deafen.description: Server-deafen a member in voice channels.

undeafen.description: Remove a server deafen from a member.

vcmute.description: Server-mute a member in voice channels.

unvcmute.description: Remove a server voice-mute from a member.

lock.description: Lock a channel to prevent members from sending messages.

lockdown.description: Lock all channels in the server simultaneously.

temprole.description: Temporarily assign a role to a member for a set duration.

removetemprole.description: Remove a temporary role assignment early.

rolepersist.description: Persist roles on a member so they are re-applied if they rejoin.

case.description: Look up the details of a moderation case by its ID.

unwarn.description: Remove (void) a warning from a member.

duration.description: Edit the duration of an active timed punishment.

reason.description: Edit the reason on an existing moderation case.

retime.description: Reset the timer on an active timed punishment.

note.description: Add a private staff note to a member's record.

notes.description: View all staff notes on a member.

clearnotes.description: Clear all staff notes from a member's record.

editnote.description: Edit the text of an existing staff note.

modlogs.description: View the full moderation history of a member.

members.description: List all active moderation cases in the server.

moderations.description: List all moderation actions taken by a specific moderator.

modstats.description: Show moderation action statistics for a moderator.

warnings.description: View all active warnings for a member.
